vibe_rationale: Strong surf culture core with film, art, music and a single-fin final, curated by a respected surf filmmaker; one scene rather than SURPLUS's many, with some commercial partners.
fit_notes: Adult, active coastal crowd close to wellness and recovery, with hydration and sun-care partners already on board (Posca Hydrate and Sun Bum), so non-endemic and health brands partner here. Check category conflicts with those partners before pitching a recovery role, as the partner route is a generic inbox.
